explore_bundled_claim: Aberrant nuclear accumulation triggers NPC injury in sALS/C9 iPSC-MNs (Coyne 2021)
key_risk_or_taste_question: Partial ASO knockdown rescues NPCs preclinically, but complete loss risks mitotic nuclear-envelope sealing defects; check gene-liability.
gnomad_essentiality_check: HIGH_LIABILITY_FOR_COMPLETE_ABLATION: gnomAD v4 pLI=0.9996, LOEUF=0.430 (15 obs/53.7 exp LoF, lof_z=4.48); OpenTargets DepMap isEssential=TRUE across 1,258 screens (mean Chronos=-0.6565, 66.2% lines <-0.5); 2026 studies show CHMP7 is required for cortical neuron activity-regulated gene expression (PMID:41744617) and telomere integrity (PMID:41677621).
druggability_check: INTRATHECAL_ASO_PARTIAL_LOWERING_OR_NUCLEAR_IMPORT_BLOCKADE: Zero active clinical trials (NCT=0). Bulk/snRNA-seq mRNA is flat after GC+cell-composition adjustment (NYGC Motor +0.0302 p=0.5742 n=59; Pineda BA4 Excitatory -0.1224 p=0.2262 n=32) because pathology is SUN1-facilitated nuclear retention (PMID:34321318, PMID:37639327), requiring titrated 30-50% knockdown or nuclear-influx PPI inhibition rather than deep ablation.

explore_bundled_claim: Rare dominant ALS/FTD-3 mutant gene + mild 3'UTR dPAS (+0.071)
key_risk_or_taste_question: CHMP2B mutations are gain-of-function C-terminal truncations in ultra-rare FTD3/ALS, and WT CHMP2B knockdown impairs autophagy! Should be separated from CHMP7 lowering.
gnomad_essentiality_check: PARALOG_COMPENSATED_IN_MITOSIS_BUT_NEURONAL_REPAIR_AND_AUTOPHAGY_REQUIRED: gnomAD v4 pLI=2.62e-6, LOEUF=1.054 (22 obs/29.8 exp LoF) and DepMap mean Chronos=+0.0259 (CHMP2A paralog compensates in dividing lines), proving ALS17/FTD3 CHMP2B^Intron5 acts via toxic C-terminal truncation GoF; however, in post-mitotic neurons WT CHMP2B partners with ANXA11 for stress-induced nuclear-envelope/plasma-membrane repair (PMID:42349418) and autophagosome maturation, creating severe liability if deeply knocked down or co-ablated with LoF-intolerant CHMP7 (pLI=0.9996, LOEUF=0.430).
druggability_check: STRICTLY_UNBUNDLED_EXPLORATORY_PARTIAL_ASO: Zero clinical trials (NCT=0). Keeley et al. 2024 (PMID:39709457) showed endogenous WT CHMP2B promotes nuclear CHMP7 accumulation in sALS iPSC-MNs and partial CHMP2B knockdown mitigates NPC injury/TDP-43 dysfunction, alongside Spillman 2026 CHMP2B protein elevation (+0.337, p=0.0233 FCx homogenate; +0.566, p=0.0213 iPSC insoluble pellet) and modest Zeng 2025 3'-UTR lengthening (PAS_ID_up=chr3:87255498:+ [0.8218->0.8928], PAS_ID_down=chr3:87254222:+, Delta_PAS_usage=+0.0709, padj=1.88e-3); requires head-to-head testing (CHMP7-only vs partial CHMP2B-only vs dual KD under NE rupture challenge) before any co-targeting.
